facts.text: Villa & Palazzo Aminta overlooks the Gulf of the Borromean Islands in Stresa, on Lake Maggiore.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the enchanting Gulf of the Borromean Islands in Stresa, Villa & Palazzo Aminta is a precious gem of the international chain

facts.text: The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
facts.excerpt: Villa & Palazzo Aminta is a precious gem of the international chain **The Leading Hotels of the World**

facts.text: Beatrice, Roberto and Daniela Zanetta welcome guests to Villa & Palazzo Aminta.
facts.excerpt: **Beatrice, Roberto and Daniela Zanetta** give their warm welcome to You

facts.text: An Italian Patio sits at the heart of the hotel, with newer rooms arranged around it.
facts.excerpt: Like a beating heart, the evocative Italian Patio spreads care and passion into the new rooms that embrace it

facts.text: Interiors feature Venetian terrazzo-style floors, shining marble columns and precious fabrics on the walls.
facts.excerpt: The floors are Venetian terrazzo style, the columns are made of shining marble, the standards and the precious fabrics on the walls wrap the rooms in a soft light

facts.text: The event halls have direct access from the external entrance, suited to large events and car presentations.
facts.excerpt: Direct access from the external entrance to the Halls makes these spaces ideal for hosting big events and car presentations with great style.

facts.text: I Mori Restaurant serves candlelit dinners in the evening.
facts.excerpt: In the evening, a romantic candlelit dinner awaits you at the delightful I Mori Restaurant

facts.text: The hotel has a spa offering treatments.
facts.excerpt: or you can relax in the welcoming SPA

facts.text: The hotel has a pet-friendly concept.
facts.excerpt: Discover our pet-friendly concept

facts.text: There is a Tesla connector for electric cars, up to 22 kW.
facts.excerpt: Tesla connector up to 22kw

facts.text: Accommodation includes lake-view suites such as the Liz Taylor Suite and La Borromea Suite, plus the Amintina Luxury Service Apartment.
facts.excerpt: Liz Taylor Suite Lake View

facts.text: The hotel has a swimming pool overlooking the lake and a solarium with a view of the Borromean Islands.
facts.excerpt: Available to guests at the Hotel, there is the beautiful swimming pool overlooking the lake and the solarium with a magnificent view of the Borromean Islands.

facts.text: The hotel has a beach and moorings used for summer water sports such as water-skiing, parasailing and watercraft.
facts.excerpt: There are numerous summer water sports like water-skiing, parasailing and watercraft, which can be practiced by making use of the beach and the moorings with which the Hotel is equipped.

facts.text: Guests can rent recreational motorboats for trips to the islands, departing from the hotel's piers.
facts.excerpt: guests can rent recreational motorboats to organize trips to the Islands and excursions departing from our piers.

facts.text: The hotel offers a bicycle service for visiting Stresa and the surrounding area.
facts.excerpt: The Hotel also offers a convenient and fun bicycle service for visiting Stresa and the surrounding areas

facts.text: Nearby Italian and Swiss mountain ranges give access to ski resorts in winter.
facts.excerpt: The nearby Italian and Swiss mountain ranges make it possible to get to the best ski resorts and practice all the alpine winter sports.

facts.text: The hotel's nature park has palm trees, azaleas, camellias and rhododendrons.
facts.excerpt: including tall palm trees and azalea bushes, camellias and flowering rhododendrons

facts.text: Riding stables are a few minutes from the villa.
facts.excerpt: A few minutes from the Villa, you can reach stables allowing you to ride in harmony with nature.

facts.text: The hotel has its own wine cellar.
facts.excerpt: Bottle of wine, selection of the Villa Aminta wine cellar, free with your dinner

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as set in one of the world's most elegant and exclusive settings.
facts.excerpt: experiencing sensational emotions in one of the world's most elegant and exclusive settings
